note: Small wooded campground on the lake shore beside the picnic area and fishing pier. Sites 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 back onto the lake, which ReserveMN puts less than 100 feet behind them through the trees. The park has no office; it is run from Sibley State Park. --Claude

Not waterfront kept; lakeview lead on 4, 6, 8, 10, 12. Pin OK (70 m). Phone none -> 320-347-7810 (Sibley SP).
